name: TabletProfile
css: .tablet-profile-page{min-height:100vh;background:#f5f7fa;font-family:'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.top-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:64px;padding:0 24px;background:#ffffff;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f2f5;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100}.nav-left{display:flex;align-items:center}.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.logo-text{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#1A365D}.nav-center{flex:1;display:flex;justify-content:center}.page-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#1A365D;margin:0}.nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}.nav-icon{cursor:pointer}.user-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A365D 0%,#2a5298 100%);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer}.main-content{flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:300px 1fr 300px;gap:20px;padding:20px;overflow:hidden}.left-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;overflow-y:auto}.user-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A365D 0%,#2a5298 100%);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;color:#ffffff;text-align:center}.user-avatar-large{width:100px;height:100px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 16px}.user-name{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 4px}.user-role{font-size:14px;opacity:0.8;margin:0 0 20px}.user-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}.stat-item{text-align:center}.stat-item .stat-value{display:block;font-size:22px;font-weight:700}.stat-item .stat-label{display:block;font-size:12px;opacity:0.8;margin-top:4px}.menu-card{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:8px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.menu-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.menu-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}.menu-item:hover{background:#f8f9fc}.menu-icon{width:36px;height:36px;background:#f5f7fa;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.menu-name{flex:1;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:#1a2b5f}.logout-btn{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:14px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #ffccc7;border-radius:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#c41e3a;cursor:pointer}.logout-btn:hover{background:#fff2f0}.center-content{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;overflow-y:auto}.data-section,.trend-section{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.section-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}.section-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#1a2b5f;margin:0}.section-action{font-size:13px;color:#1890ff;cursor:pointer}.data-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}.data-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:20px 12px;background:#f8f9fc;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer}.data-card:hover{background:#f0f2f5;transform:translateY(-2px)}.data-icon{width:48px;height:48px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.08)}.data-value{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;color:#1a2b5f;margin-bottom:4px}.data-label{font-size:13px;color:#8899aa}.trend-chart{height:150px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}.chart-bars{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;width:100%;height:100%}.bar-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;flex:1}.bar-value{font-size:11px;color:#5a6488;margin-bottom:4px}.bar{width:32px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1A365D 0%,#2a5298 100%);border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;min-height:4px}.bar-label{font-size:12px;color:#5a6488;margin-top:6px}.right-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;overflow-y:auto}.calendar-card,.badge-card{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.card-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}.card-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#1a2b5f;margin:0}.card-action{font-size:12px;color:#1890ff;cursor:pointer}.exam-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.exam-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;background:#f8f9fc;border-radius:8px}.exam-date{text-align:center;min-width:48px}.exam-month{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#8899aa}.exam-day{display:block;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#1A365D}.exam-info{flex:1}.exam-name{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#1a2b5f}.exam-countdown{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#8899aa;margin-top:2px}.badge-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}.badge-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px}.badge-icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.badge-name{font-size:11px;color:#5a6488;text-align:center}.bottom-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:40px;padding:0 24px;background:#ffffff;border-top:1px solid #f0f2f5}.bar-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}.online-status,.sync-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:#5a6488}.version{font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}@media(max-width:1024px){.main-content{grid-template-columns:1fr}.left-panel,.right-panel{display:none}}
